description: Staged event-page indexing batches beyond the frozen pilot (owner decision 2026-10-09: widen event-page indexing in staged batches). Experimental metadata only: the runtime lists are EVENT_INDEXING_BATCHES in functions/_event-indexing-batches.js, which npm run test:event-indexability pins to the keys below. A batch is frozen once merged: never regenerate, extend or replace its members; a member that becomes ineligible drops out of indexing on its own and stays listed here. The next batch is proposed by node scripts/select-event-indexing-batch.mjs and added by a reviewed PR.

batches.launch_note: launch_date is the day production first serves these pages index,follow (the merge of this batch), recorded after production verification. Measurement windows run from that date.

rules: eligible under eventIndexabilityDecision on selection day (served 200, parent artist indexable, upcoming, not held, commercially live, a performance, one valid MusicEvent, >=2 publishable destinations, >=2 snapshot-ready lanes, no duplicate ambiguity)
not in the pilot or an earlier batch
no needs_recheck anywhere in the record
every date spelled in a provider URL reads as the event's venue-local date
at least 21 days out on selection day
at most 6 pages per artist; single-date artist-city cases first, then most destinations, most snapshot-ready lanes, soonest date
selection.composition: 250 pages, 62 artists; artist-city {"single_date":250}; countries {"United States":222,"Canada":11,"United Kingdom":17}; destinations {"5":233,"6":17}; snapshot-ready lanes {"2":55,"3":195}
